description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'Language' class in the 'Opencart' e-commerce platform. The class contains methods to manipulate language variables during different stages of controller execution, such as templating, pre-processing, and post-processing.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Manages language variables during the lifecycle of a controller, including providing variables to templates, backing up, and restoring language data.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Injects all language variables into the provided arguments array if they are not already set.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Backs up current language data by serializing it and storing it under the 'backup' key.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Restores language data from the backup stored prior to controller execution.
